description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter news app, including routing, theming, app initialization, and biometric authentication gate. It integrates local notifications, Firebase messaging, and manages app-wide state.

classes.name: NewsApp
classes.description: Main StatelessWidget that sets up the app's theme, routes, and biometric authentication gating, serving as the entry point for the Flutter application.

classes.name: _NotificationBootstrapper
classes.description: Stateful widget responsible for initializing local and push notifications when the app starts.

classes.name: _NotificationBootstrapperState
classes.description: State class for _NotificationBootstrapper that manages async initialization of notification services.

classes.name: _BiometricGate
classes.description: Stateful widget that acts as an authentication gate, requiring biometric or device passcode authentication before rendering the main app.

classes.name: _BiometricGateState
classes.description: State class handling biometric authentication logic, app lifecycle events, and re-authentication logic.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: Simple screen shown when route navigation receives missing or invalid arguments.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Constructs and returns the app's Material 3 theme data with custom color scheme and component styles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for NewsApp, wrapping MaterialApp with biometric gating and notification initialization.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes widget state, sets up lifecycle observers, and starts biometric authentication check.

methods.name: didChangeAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle to determine when to require re-authentication based on background duration.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric or device credential authentication, returning true if successful.

methods.name: _localizedReasonWithFallbackHint
methods.description: Provides localized prompt message based on available biometric types.

methods.name: _checkAndAuthenticate
methods.description: Executes the authentication logic, managing error handling and state updates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the authentication gate UI, showing locking UI if not authenticated.
